current_prompt.body:
READ the list of 45 distinct positive integers
DETERMINE whether the list can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for each triple

ELSE
    RETURN a statement that no such partition exists
